ns2:section.sectionText: New freshmen in Grainger College of Engineering, Math&CS, Stat&CS, ChemE or Physics must enroll in lecture EL1 or EL2. Continuing students in these programs who register after June 3, 2022 should e-mail mathadvising@illinois.edu with name, UIN, and continuing status to receive an override to register for AL1/AL2/AL3
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for Grainger Engineering. Not intended for Physics or Chemical Engineering or Statistics & Computer Science or Math & Computer Science major(s).
